inputs: Frozen raw ChEMBL and ZINC snapshots; existing prepared receptors and ligand inputs copied and hashed.
limitations: No new ChEMBL/ZINC download; reproduce saved dataset.
Prepared receptor chemistry is reused, not independently revalidated by this execution.
RMSD uses saved CCD connectivity query without pose alignment; bond orders and stereochemistry are not enforced.
No Boltz or molecular dynamics workflow exists in this project.
